description: Vector form field annotations and text overlays positioned on top of a scanned form background

source.generation_method: Generated via tests/fixtures/hybrid/hybrid-002-generator.py using raw PDF construction: vector form field annotations (field labels, small red checkboxes, underline rectangles) with 1-bit grayscale image XObject (scanned employee information form background)

hybrid_behavior.vector_regions: Form field annotations scattered throughout page: field label text (Helvetica, 9-10pt), red checkbox indicators (top-left corner), underline rectangles for text input fields, overlay annotations describing each field
hybrid_behavior.scanned_regions: Complete form background (all 8x8 grid cells): 1-bit grayscale image XObject with employee information form layout including title, field labels, underline patterns, section headers, certification text, and signature line
hybrid_behavior.overlap_description: Vector form field annotations overlay scanned form background at multiple positions: field name overlays, checkbox overlays in corners, underline rectangles directly over scanned underlines, creating complex overlapping patterns

grid_cell_coverage.hybrid_cell_locations: Most grid cells contain both vector annotations (field labels, checkboxes, underlines) and scanned form background. Only top and bottom edge cells may be predominantly scanned-only.

classification_challenges: Scattered vector distribution: vector annotations are distributed across the page rather than concentrated in a single region, making boundary detection difficult
Complex merge patterns: multiple small vector spans (text, rectangles, checkboxes) overlapping with larger scanned regions require precise bbox overlap calculations
Field-level extraction requires accurate OCR targeting to avoid duplicating vector field labels with scanned labels
Tests cell-level OCR granularity when vector form fields are interspersed throughout predominantly scanned form page
Vector and scanned text may overlap significantly (field labels), testing merge rule IoU thresholds
Small vector elements (checkboxes) may be missed by coarse grid detection
test_focus: Scattered vector extraction through cell-level OCR on form fields
Complex merge pattern handling with multiple overlapping vector and scanned regions
Form field isolation from scanned background labels
Cell-level OCR precision on hybrid forms with field annotations
Merge rule accuracy when vector and scanned text overlap significantly
notes: Synthetic fixture simulating a common real-world hybrid PDF pattern: a scanned paper form with vector fillable field annotations overlaid. This tests the hybrid extraction pipeline's ability to handle scattered vector content distributed across a predominantly scanned page. The vector elements include form field labels, small red checkbox indicators, underline rectangles for text input areas, and descriptive overlay annotations. The scanned background provides a complete employee information form layout. Key challenge: accurate merge of vector and scanned text when they describe the same field (e.g., 'Full Name:' appears in both vector and scanned regions).
